input.message:
Subject: 27 Thistle Lane, Brackley Vale ZZ3 9ZZ – bedroom radiator (ref R/12) – your decision needed

Dear Landlord,

Thank you for approving the bedroom radiator repair with Harlow Heating up to £150. We contacted Harlow Heating and they are fully booked until 3 November. They have offered an earlier emergency visit, but at double their normal rate (they have not given us a figure, so it is likely to exceed your £150 limit).

We have not booked anything. The options are:

1. Wait for Harlow Heating's first standard slot (from 3 November), within your £150 limit. The tenant's bedroom would stay without heat until then.
2. Harlow Heating emergency visit sooner at double rate – we would get their price for you first.
3. Quick Fix Heating can attend on Monday 6 October. Their quote is £230 including parts for a radiator inspection and valve replacement – £80 above your £150 limit.

Please reply with APPROVE to go ahead with Quick Fix Heating at £230, or DECLINE and tell us whether you would prefer option 1 or option 2. Nothing will go ahead above £150 or with anyone other than Harlow Heating without your say-so.

Kind regards,
Donna
Maintenance team

input.subject: 27 Thistle Lane – bedroom radiator (ref R/12) – update
input.body:
Hello,

Thank you for reporting the bedroom radiator at 27 Thistle Lane, Brackley Vale ZZ3 9ZZ (ref R/12). We have been in touch with heating engineers and are waiting on the landlord's decision on which engineer and visit date to go with. We will confirm as soon as a visit is booked – nothing is booked yet.

In the meantime, it is worth checking the valve on the radiator (the numbered knob) is turned fully open. If you are comfortable doing so and have a radiator key, bleeding the radiator with the heating off and cool can sometimes fix this – please stop if water keeps coming out.

So we can prioritise properly, please let us know if anyone in the home is elderly, unwell, very young or otherwise particularly affected by the cold, and whether checking the valve helped.

Kind regards,
Donna
Maintenance team
